en.title: JPG to WebP – Convert JPG and PNG Images to WebP Online Free
en.description: Convert JPG or PNG to WebP online for free. Drop one or many images, pick the quality, and download smaller WebP files for faster websites. Runs in your browser – nothing is uploaded.

quality.label: Quality
quality.help: Higher quality keeps more detail but makes a bigger file. 85 looks almost identical to the original.

errors.noWebp: This browser cannot create WebP images. Try Chrome, Edge, Firefox or a recent Safari.

faq: Why use WebP?
WebP files are usually 25–35% smaller than JPG at the same visual quality and keep PNG transparency, so pages load faster.
Are my images uploaded?
No. Each image is converted on your device with your browser and never sent to a server.
